row.title: Launch-day failures are root-caused in code: work not pulse, duplicate PRs, ledger deferrals, word claims
row.body: Audit 2026-11-25: the What Works reader had read nothing (gpt-oss spent its 400-token cap reasoning, every reply empty, logged not JSON) while /health said ticking; four sessions built knowledge-graph engines in parallel; a decision row deferred a pre-approved deploy to the owner; showcase copy said five policy areas (code: twelve). Guards: duplicate PRs are COLLISION-1 (foundation/collisions.py, built in parallel by another session; this session's overlap.py was dropped for it), standingorder ledger lint, claimcode word-number patterns, what-works rootcause tests and work-based /health.
